description: Implementation of a thread pool class and related functions for managing worker threads, including default thread count calculation, thread management, task execution, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: TaskThreadPoolBase
classes.description: Base class providing default thread count calculation based on hardware info.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker threads to execute tasks asynchronously.

methods.name: defaultNumThreads
methods.description: Calculates default number of threads based on hardware cores and processors.

methods.name: ThreadPool
methods.description: Constructor initializing thread pool with specified size, NUMA node, and optional thread initialization.

methods.name: ~ThreadPool
methods.description: Destructor that joins all threads and cleans up.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of threads in the pool.

methods.name: numAvailable
methods.description: Returns the number of available threads.

methods.name: inThreadPool
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is part of the thread pool.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Submits a task to the thread pool for execution.

methods.name: waitWorkComplete
methods.description: Blocks until all submitted work is completed.

methods.name: main_loop
methods.description: Main execution loop for each worker thread, processing tasks.
